SELECT sl.stocktake_line_id AS stocktakeLineId, sl.stocktake_id AS stocktakeId, sl.inventory_id AS inventoryId,
sl.item_id AS itemId, mi.item_code AS itemCode, mi.item_name AS itemName,
sl.batch_id AS batchId, mb.batch_no AS batchNo,
sl.location_id AS locationId, wl.location_code AS locationCode,
sl.book_qty AS bookQty, sl.counted_qty AS countedQty, sl.difference_qty AS differenceQty, sl.line_status AS lineStatus
FROM inv_stocktake_line sl
LEFT JOIN md_item mi ON mi.item_id = sl.item_id
LEFT JOIN md_batch mb ON mb.batch_id = sl.batch_id
LEFT JOIN wh_location wl ON wl.location_id = sl.location_id
WHERE sl.stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId}
ORDER BY sl.stocktake_line_id
